title: American Greed
description:
S11 E11 — From Peanuts to Sick Millions
Nine people are killed and thousands sickened when a CEO knowingly ships peanut products tainted with salmonella.

title: American Greed
description:
S8 E85 — Make Me Rich or Die; Kids for Cash
A man threatens investment professionals to make him rich; two judges get rich off of a secret deal to build juvenile detention centers.

title: American Greed
description:
S11 E19 — Lesson in Greed; Soldier Scam
A school supply vendor steals millions from Detroit public schools by enlisting shady school officials; crooks use photos of real military men to lure women into sending them love and money.

title: American Greed
description:
S12 E2 — Deadly Opioids, Dirty Doctors
Two doctors run their Alabama pain clinics like heartless pill mills-illegally prescribing opioids while destroying lives and pocketing millions.

title: American Greed
description:
S12 E4 — The Polka King Con
Polka band leader Jan Lewan rips off his adoring fans with false promises of sizable investment returns.

title: American Greed
description:
S12 E10 — Florida Rehab Gone Wild
Kenny Chatman runs a string of corrupt drug rehab facilities in South Florida stealing millions by keeping insured addicts hooked on drugs; his plans include turning patients into prostitutes and sober homes into drug-fueled brothels.

title: American Greed
description:
S5 E3 — Fool's Gold
Philanthropist, diplomat, international man of mystery, and criminal Dr Henry Jones led a double-life that was unknown to all he knew.

title: American Greed
description:
S9 E4 — A Widow's Web
After golf, millionaire Gary Triano puts the keys into the ignition and is killed instantly by a car bomb, uncovering a bizarre murder-for-hire plot hatched by his ex-wife and her lover that's revealed in a series of recorded conversations.

title: American Greed
description:
S7 E5 — Wild West Rip-Off
A charismatic New Mexico real estate broker scams $75 million in a fake land investment program.

title: American Greed
description:
S7 E4 — Deadly Payout
A trio of Texas conmen score $100 million by telling investors there's big money in the life settlement insurance business.

title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — There Goes the Neighborhood
Welcome to Limon Correctional Facility, a level 4 prison that houses many of Colorado's most dangerous inmates; while visiting Limon Correctional, the Lockup crew is greeted by angry inmates and the cell extraction team is called in to help.

title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Love Hurts
Even for inmates serving hard time, love can be a strong motivator; in prison, reaching out to others can be a dicey proposition; some inmates just don't know when someone's getting too close until it's too late.

title: Lockup: Orange County: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Cabin Fever
Unlike prison inmates who have already been convicted and sentenced for their crimes, most jail inmates stand charged and are still working their cases through the court system; the process can take years, so some try to make their jail cells home.

title: Lockup: Charleston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Fallen Leaf
An inmate finds himself at the center of more than one battle, and he traces his problems back to the real-life nightmare that haunts his family; a young new arrival faces a charge of reckless homicide.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Enough is Enough
A repeat offender smuggles in contraband and an inmate becomes a marked man after murdering a Louisville rap star; a prescription pill epidemic takes its toll on the jail and drug use on the inside could keep another inmate from leaving.

title: Lockup: Cleveland: Extended Stay
description:
S16 E4 — Rush
In the Cuyahoga Country Correction Center's intake department an out-of-control inmate creates chaos; an inmate who has spent 24 years on Death Row may be facing freedom.

title: Lockup: Cincinnati: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Dead Run
A heroin addict must choose between the lifestyle she craves and the young son she has left behind; another seasoned female inmate is transferred back to the jail from state prison, but she suddenly finds herself on the wrong end of a fist.

title: Lockup: Oakland: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — To PC or Not to PC
A celebrity rapper enters the Santa Rita jail, but his arrest leaves a heartbroken girlfriend behind; two brothers deal with gangs, drugs and parenthood and a three-time convicted murderer claims he's killed others as well.
